rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when expressing approval by clapping.

example.english: Everyone began to applaud after the play.
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 tai2 jyun4 coeng4 hei3 zau6 paak3 sau2

rows.note: Choose this for openly praising or approving of a person, action, or idea.

example.english: We really should applaud this approach.
example.traditional: 我哋真係要讚呢個做法。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zan1 hai6 jiu3 zaan3 ni1 go3 zou6 faat3

rows.note: Choose this when the approval specifically means affirming or recognizing someone's merits or motives.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 hang2 ding6 nei5 ge3 nou5 lik6
